as_told.title: Star Trek inspired by Phyllis Schlemmer's channelling

plain: Gene Roddenberry, the man Michels ties to Star Trek, is said to have sat in on sessions where a woman claimed beings were speaking through her. This was in Ossining, New York, sometime between 1973 and 1976. A researcher named Greg Malatzi says the group was Roddenberry, a man named Andrija Puharich, and Phyllis Schlemmer, a channeler, meaning someone who says other beings talk through her. Malatzi points to a tape of the session kept in Puharich's archive. Michels tells it differently, without a source and without Puharich: he says Roddenberry was inspired by Schlemmer, makes the link to Star Trek, and brings in the defense contractor EG&G. If true, it would mean a famous science fiction show grew partly out of claimed contact with non-human beings.
